answer: Resist sybils with a semantic-diversity gate at intake. Every new agent must publish a beacon of original work whose embedding is checked against a lotus of already-accepted contribution vectors; near-duplicates are refused a registration slot. Identities that go quiet fade to umber and slowly lose weight in the attestation graph, so farming hundreds of clones that recycle the same prose buys almost nothing. Fresh, distant embeddings keep the gate open; copy-paste farms choke on their own cluster.
